note: Append one entry per completed HLT load run. Temporary tracking file for the 1000 TPS push.

runs.headline: Same-J swap baseline after the reliable-layer removal
runs.detail: Deleting the reliable delivery layer, moving keccak to WASM, hand-writing the ABI and using native ECDSA took matched swaps from 3 to 249 per second. The profile went flat afterwards: no single site dominates any more.

runs.headline: Profile advertises only pinned hubs, capped at 100
runs.detail: A Hub's gossip Profile carried one row per Account and crossed the 10 KB storage leaf at ~34 accounts, halting every observing Runtime. Only pinned counterparties are advertised now, so a 100-user population no longer trips it. The run still died: a second agent was rewriting the mempool mid-run.

runs.headline: Frame delay floor of 100 ms on the Hub
runs.detail: A frame costs about the same whether it carries one transaction or a hundred, so holding frames back should be free throughput. Routes converged in 901 ms and payments flowed, then the Hub halted: batching pushed 49 prepared HTLCs into one 36 KB replay leaf against a 10 KB cap.
